fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Vincario API key included in signed request paths. Request API access at https://vincario.com/vin-decoder/#request-free-trial-api-key.

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.description: Vincario secret key used locally to calculate request control sums; it is never sent upstream.

actions.name: check_stolen
actions.description: Check a VIN against the stolen-vehicle sources available through Vincario.

vin.description: The 17-character vehicle identification number to look up.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a Vincario VIN lookup.

price.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

price_currency.description: The currency or credit unit reported for the request price.

balance.description: Remaining credits grouped by Vincario service.

code.description: The country or Vincario database source code.

status.description: The stolen-vehicle status reported by the source.

stolen.description: Stolen-vehicle checks returned by each available source.

outputSchema.description: The stolen-vehicle check returned by Vincario.

actions.name: decode_vin
actions.description: Decode a VIN into detailed vehicle specifications with Vincario.

vin.description: The 17-character vehicle identification number to look up.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a Vincario VIN lookup.

price.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

price_currency.description: The currency or credit unit reported for the request price.

balance.description: Remaining credits grouped by Vincario service.

value.description: The decoded value, whose type depends on the attribute.

outputSchema.description: The decoded vehicle data returned by Vincario.

actions.name: get_balance
actions.description: Get the remaining Vincario credits for each API service.

actions.name: get_vehicle_market_value
actions.description: Estimate a vehicle's market price and odometer statistics from its VIN.

vin.description: The 17-character vehicle identification number to look up.

odometer.description: Optional odometer reading used for the price-adjusted estimate.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for estimating a vehicle's market value.

price.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

price_currency.description: The currency or credit unit reported for the request price.

balance.description: Remaining credits grouped by Vincario service.

vehicle.description: Decoded vehicle details used for the estimate.

period.description: The market-data period used for the estimate.

market_price.description: Market price statistics grouped by region.

market_odometer.description: Market odometer statistics grouped by region.

outputSchema.description: The vehicle identity and market-value estimates returned by Vincario.

actions.name: get_vin_decode_info
actions.description: List the vehicle fields Vincario can decode for a VIN without charging credits.

vin.description: The 17-character vehicle identification number to look up.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a Vincario VIN lookup.

price.description: The number of credits charged for the request.

price_currency.description: The currency or credit unit reported for the request price.

balance.description: Remaining credits grouped by Vincario service.

decode.description: Decode field labels available for the VIN.

outputSchema.description: The available decode fields for the supplied VIN.
